name: Short Cut Indian Chicken Tikka Masala with Tomatoes, Basmati Rice & Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, and medium dice tomatoes; place in a small bowl and set aside. Cut chicken crosswise into 1/2-inch thick pieces.
Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat. Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add chicken, salt, and pepper; cook, stirring occasionally, until golden, 2-3 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tsp neutral vegetable oil
½ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes and tikka masala curry sauce to the skillet, then stir to combine. Bring to a simmer, then reduce heat to medium-low and cook, stirring occasionally, until the chicken is cooked through and tomatoes are soft, 6-8 min.
instructions.secondary_message: 1 (15 oz) jar Indian tikka masala curry sauce

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, squeeze pouches to separate rice, then tear a two-inch opening at the top of each to vent. Place both packages in the microwave and heat on high until warmed through, 2-2 1/2 minutes. Carefully remove from microwave and set aside to cool slightly.
To serve, divide rice between plates or bowls. Top with chicken tikka masala and yogurt. Enjoy!
